<subject>Tasman Ridge Resources - Optimising Logistics & IT Spend</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, flexibility, and continuous operational efficiency are the hallmarks of our partners at Global Logistics Solutions (GLS). Their agile on/off site and offshore 24x7 delivery model is perfectly suited for a full spectrum of logistics and IT outsourcing services - from rail network maintenance, system development, and modernisation to complete technology outsourcing, including data centre operations for mining.

GLS can offer Tasman Ridge their certified Microsoft and SAP professionals, available at A$25/hr to work on your projects. They have nearly 500 employees and state-of-the-art development facilities. GLS's centres in Bengaluru are considered the "crown jewel" of their operations and a key differentiator for Tasman Ridge.

https://www.globallogisticssolutions.com/

Over the years, their Global Technology Centres (GTCs) in Bengaluru have achieved an impressive record of project accomplishments for their Australian, European, and Asian customers.

Their Innovation Centres (ICs) and GTCs offer the following capabilities for our customers:

   a. Rail Network Optimisation
   b. Port Logistics Management and Supply Chain Integration
   c. Application Re-engineering Services
   d. Legacy System Porting Services
   e. 24x7 Help Desk/Call Centre Support Services

Although all of their services can be accomplished in one of their domestic facilities, our customers gain significant added value by utilising the power of their offshore capabilities. Please visit https://www.globallogisticssolutions.com/

This 24x7 development and delivery model enables GLS to scale project staffing rapidly to meet client needs, to engage in concurrent development, and to employ a virtual 24-hour workday on client projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can set a quick meeting to discuss these details. Look forward to hearing from you soon.

Regards,

Martha Soto
martha.soto@tasmanridge.com.au
